answer.book: A 1684 Latin disputation (dissertatio) defended at Bern by respondent Daniel Vulpius under Professor J. R. Rodolph: a title page, a dedication to Daniel Imhoof, and one dissertation on time, day and week, divided into headed sections and numbered §§, followed by an appendix of the respondent.

entries.title: Dissertatio philologico-isagogica ad chronologiam S. et eccles. Prima.

Viro consultissimo, prudentissimo ac literatissimo, Dn. Danieli Imhoof, præfecturis Grandisonensi et Lausannensi, summa cum laude defuncto, e sacro baptismatis fonte susceptori suo benignissimo, tanquam patri omni honoris genere suspiciendo.
De tempore in genere, die et septimana.
